title: Visual naturalness can support sincerity

exclusions: Do not assign honesty, luxury or gender to a material without project and audience context.

title: Image formats should follow use hierarchy
principle: A content library becomes more useful when its crops, orientation and scene variety are planned around actual channel and placement needs.
summary: Platform requirement is a primary project fact, not an aesthetic afterthought.

title: Avoiding clichés requires replacing their function
principle: A cliché should be replaced by a more specific visual proof of the same communication need, not simply removed.
summary: If a user rejects generic personal-brand imagery, ask what the cliché was trying to signal — competence, availability, lifestyle, collaboration — and find a truer proof surface.
visualImplications: Replace laptop-at-desk with material/process, real teaching/explaining, client-world relation, movement or authored environment when relevant.
applicableWhen: The user rejects stock-photo feeling, trend-led imagery or generic founder photography.
exclusions: Avoid novelty for novelty’s sake; the replacement must still make the business easy to understand.

title: Campaign coherence needs recurring rules
principle: A coherent campaign can vary scenes while repeating a limited number of visual rules such as light behaviour, tonal family, framing logic, materials or movement register.

title: Creative direction should retain unresolved tensions
principle: Conflicting user signals can be a meaningful creative tension rather than an error to average away.
summary: Preserve a named tension when it is supported by evidence; later direction can use it to avoid generic middle-ground output.
visualImplications: Record pairs such as authority-warmth, raw-polished, minimal-expressive or controlled-spontaneous, with evidence and context.
applicableWhen: The user’s words, image choices or references support both sides under different conditions.
exclusions: Do not force a false midpoint or turn a low-confidence conflict into a definitive brand identity.
